inventory.name: Sunpetal
inventory.description: A golden petal that stores daylight. It stays warm long after sunset.

inventory.name: Stonebloom
inventory.description: A flower with petals of layered slate. It grows in cracks where nothing else will.

inventory.name: Galeorchid
inventory.description: An orchid that leans into a wind no one else can feel. Its petals whistle softly.

inventory.name: Stormlily
inventory.description: A lily that hums before a storm. Sparks gather on its stamens like dew.

inventory.name: Radiant Orb
inventory.description:
✦ ✦ ✦ ✦ ✦ ·

Light moves beneath the surface like a choir breathing. Held close, you can almost hear the harmonies overlap.

Grade: Chord — 4 front / 2 bench
Next: Crescendo — collect 10+ distinct girls across 5+ races, and marry one

inventory.name: Manabloom
inventory.description: A flower whose petals rearrange themselves into faint runes when no one is watching.

inventory.name: Nightbloom
inventory.description: A flower that only opens in darkness. Looking at it too long makes the room feel smaller.

inventory.name: Emberbloom
inventory.description: A flower that smoulders without ash. Its petals keep a forge-hot glow for days after picking.

inventory.name: Frostlotus
inventory.description: A lotus that blooms on black ice. Its chill never melts, even beside an open forge.

inventory.name: Ironbriar
inventory.description: A stubborn briar with iron-hard thorns. Smiths fold it into physical gear to push it to the next grade.

inventory.name: Looking Glass Shard
inventory.description: A splinter of glass that reflects nothing from this world — only things that aren't yet. Held to the sealed book in the Veilholt Arcane Tower, it opens the road to Wonderland.

inventory.name: Sylvana's Looking Glass
inventory.description: A whole mirror, small enough to carry. Sylvana's reflection no longer lives behind it — but she still checks it when she thinks you are not looking.

inventory.name: Celestial Sigil
inventory.description: A silver sigil recovered from the thirtieth depth of a dungeon. Its etched rings turn slowly, and its light always points north — toward Celestia, the city beneath the aurora.

inventory.name: Monkey Wing
inventory.description: A pinion shed by one of the Wicked Witch's winged monkeys. It still twitches when it thinks no one is looking.
